svg.text: Row by row: dst is written down a column
Blocked: one 8×8 tile at a time
each store: a new line, 1 qword of 8 used
8 lines, all 64 qwords used, all still in L1
The top-left corner of dst (n = 128). A box with a dark outline is one
64-byte cache line: 8 qwords of a row. Lines 1024 bytes apart fall into only
4 of L1's 64 sets, so a column's lines evict each other before the next column.
